name: noether-monorepo
description: Noether monorepo root. Tranche 2 packages live under api/, indexer/, sdk-ts/, sdk-py/, packages/*. Existing web/ and scripts/keeper/ remain standalone.

scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
